items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I was in the original band... Jimmy Ford, Willie Maiden, and Bill Chase was on it

ctx.x: Yeah. This is it. From beginning to end. I was in the original band, and they’ve got the whole thing, ten CDs come with this package. And I’m playing throughout it, through the whole thing, we were the original band. Jimmy Ford, Willie Maiden, and Bill Chase was on it and so many people.
